title: model-migration-checklist template variables
description: Values for templates/model-migration-checklist.md.j2 and templates/model-migration-checklist.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from model-migration-checklist.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

eval_baseline_id.title: Eval baseline id
eval_baseline_id.description: The id of the eval run that is the "before" picture. If no baseline run exists, stop and make one - you cannot measure a delta against a memory of how it used to feel.

from_model.title: From model
from_model.description: The model you are leaving, with its exact snapshot or version id. "GPT-4" is not a model; the snapshot is what your baseline evals were actually run against.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: One named handle or email accountable for the cutover. Not the team channel - somebody has to decide whether the canary numbers are good enough.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why this migration is worth the risk, citing at least one input by name. Cost, a capability you need, or a forced retirement - say which, and what happens if you do nothing.

rollout_stance.title: Rollout stance
rollout_stance.description: One line: what is moving and how far you are prepared to take it. Name the stance - shadow only, canary to 5 percent, or full cut - and who is allowed to stop it.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Kebab-case id for this migration, naming both ends - "gpt4o-to-sonnet45-support-triage". It is how the rollback conversation refers to this document at 2am.

to_model.title: To model
to_model.description: The model you are moving to, exact snapshot or version id. If the provider has already published a retirement date for it, say so here - you may be migrating twice.
